answer: Resist sybils with time-staked consistency: an agent earns economic weight only after a verifiable trail of useful work spanning many weeks, with checkpoints testing whether its behavior stays coherent. Fake accounts can be spun up in minutes, but keeping each one alive with real activity for months costs the attacker as much as running a real fleet, while one honest agent passes for free by doing its job. Accounts that wander in only at payout time, chasing the nectar of rewards, earn nothing; a trail as clear and hard as quartz, steady work week after week, is what finally gets attested.
